# Pricing review — 2026-08-19

Attendees: Maya, Tomas, Priya, Jonah · Notes: Priya

## Discussion

- Beta survey: people who would buy annual want a bigger discount. "Two months free" (about 17%
  off) tested worse than a round 25% (see the survey results in the research folder).
- Two small teams in the beta asked to pay yearly by invoice.
- Tomas: invoicing is now possible, so an annual Team plan is no longer blocked.

## Decisions

1. The annual discount becomes **25%** on every plan. This replaces the "two months free" rule
   from pricing v1.
2. Solo annual becomes **$54 per year** (v1 said $60).
3. Team gets an annual option at **$135 per seat per year**.
4. Monthly prices stay as they are.
5. Maya writes pricing v3 by mid-September. The spreadsheet used today counts as v2 and is not
   kept.
